$comment: Add a game by appending one entry. `art` picks a procedural cover generator from src/art.js — no image files anywhere.

games.title: Boreal
games.description: Fly a manta of light across a midnight ocean beneath the aurora. Thread the rings, skim the swell to charge your surge, and don't hit the ice.

games.title: No Signal
games.description: One night on a North Atlantic island with five locations to film. Recording is the only way off — and the only thing that reliably brings it.
